findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "annapolis_list_destinations" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List the approved Annapolis downtown destination directory covering local businesses, waterfront landmarks, and public access points with coordinates and QR por…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v2" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: annapolis_list_events · Private data: annapolis_list_events · Public sink: annapolis_list_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: annapolis_list_events · Private data: annapolis_list_events · Public sink: annapolis_list_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
